name: GenHome3D model benches
note: Each bench builds one reference image with more than one model. Attribution is copied from the metadata recorded at build time, and review states are reported as the library sealed them.

benches.title: Scandinavian Birch Oval Crib
benches.summary: One generated reference image, built independently by two models.
benches.brief: Capsule plan with continuous pale birch bars, rounded ends, a fitted oval mattress, and four splayed legs.
observations: Both builds normalise to the same declared 1.42 x 0.82 x 1.00 m envelope, so they differ by interpretation rather than by size.

The reference shows the mattress carried on an inner ring inside the bar cage. CRB-0002 places a rectangular mattress that reads outside the capsule; CRB-1002 carries a capsule mattress on a modelled ring and slatted deck.

The reference stands the bars on a flat oval rim board with the legs under it. CRB-0002 merges that into a rounded base band; CRB-1002 models the board, the bar landings, and the leg mounts as separate members.
Bar rhythm differs: CRB-0002 uses fewer, heavier bars; CRB-1002 measures 46 bars at 77 mm pitch off the reference, keeping openings under the 60 mm crib-slat limit.

entries.method: Built inside the twenty-asset crib collection run, sharing tools/bedroom_cribs_asset_builder.py with the other nineteen cribs.
entries.review_note: Seven-criterion visual review sealed at collection closeout.
